gaps.sentence: Rising sea levels ___ (THREAT) the very existence of the island.
gaps.explanation: A main verb is needed after the plural subject: threaten.
'Appealed for calm' — the set phrase uses 'calm' as noun.

gaps.sentence: We owe our success to her ___ (VISION) leadership.
The shop is under new ___ (MANAGE) from Monday.
The new software ___ (ABLE) staff to work securely from anywhere.
gaps.explanation: 'Enable somebody to do something' — the present-tense verb fits the singular subject.

gaps.sentence: He made a full ___ (RECOVER) after six months.
The instructions were ___ (WRITE) in six languages.
gaps.explanation: Passive voice: were written — irregular participle of write.
